note: Queries whose first 10,000-row page is not produced by the engine within the 30 s deadline on a GitHub-hosted runner. Each is cancelled server-side at the deadline (HTTP 504, never a hang, never partial results). CRA-024 A.2 ('none exceeding 30 s') is therefore NOT met for these on that engine; they stay open until the engine/plan is improved.

investigation_2026_10_27.fuseki_tdb2_stats: tdb2.tdbstats statistics (stats.opt, 1,024,112 triples) installed and the server restarted: Q4, Q5a, Q7 still cancelled at 30.0 s; Q6 5.4 s, Q5b 0.8 s unchanged in kind. No improvement, so CI keeps the in-memory dataset.
investigation_2026_10_27.q5a_rewrite_rejected: Rewriting FILTER(?name = ?name2) into a shared-variable join (Q5b's form, 0.8 s) is not semantics-preserving in general: '=' is value equality (e.g. "1"^^xsd:integer = "01"^^xsd:integer, typed vs. language literals raise errors), a join is term identity. EOIP does not apply unsound rewrites, so Q5a stays open.
